content.title: Asymmetric Scale Exchange | Route Rewrites and Balanced Finish
content.summary: A heavy maintenance exosuit and inspection drone exchange routes around a turbine and cable bridge without a winner. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Two original opponents with an obvious scale difference and one shared landmark establish the baseline. + Every heavy committed move changes the smaller figure's route through visible spatial cause and effect. + The smaller figure remains traceable across platforms, wheel and bridge without teleportation. + At least one repeated landmark proves both opponents remain in the same continuous geography. + The terminal frame contains both opponents and preserves an unresolved, nonlethal state with no franchise likeness.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original heavy cobalt maintenance exosuit and one compact amber inspection drone on the same elevated hydro-plant service deck; show the turbine wheel, gantry and cable bridge in one geography. Track both around the same turbine wheel: the exosuit takes the upper gantry and the drone passes through one open spoke before rising on the far side. End in one wide hydro-plant frame with the exosuit stable on the deck and the drone hovering beyond the bridge; preserve the size contrast and shared geography without declaring a winner or using any recognizable franchise character.
required_anchors: Two original opponents with an obvious scale difference and one shared landmark establish the baseline.
Every heavy committed move changes the smaller figure's route through visible spatial cause and effect.
At least one repeated landmark proves both opponents remain in the same continuous geography.
The terminal frame contains both opponents and preserves an unresolved, nonlethal state with no franchise likeness.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A heavy maintenance exosuit and inspection drone exchange routes around a turbine and cable bridge without a winner. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 在同一可追踪地理中建立体量悬殊的两方，让重型角色以明确承诺动作压迫路线，小型角色通过平台、转轮和桥面连续改道而非瞬移；终局保持双方同场且不凭空宣布胜负。仅迁移运动机制，不保留来源角色、服装、世界观或IP外观。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: Two original opponents with an obvious scale difference and one shared landmark establish the baseline.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "Two original opponents with an obvious scale difference and one shared landmark establish the baseline."

invariants.rule: Every heavy committed move changes the smaller figure's route through visible spatial cause and effect.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every heavy committed move changes the smaller figure's route through visible spatial cause and effect."

invariants.rule: The smaller figure remains traceable across platforms, wheel and bridge without teleportation.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The smaller figure remains traceable across platforms, wheel and bridge without teleportation."

invariants.rule: At least one repeated landmark proves both opponents remain in the same continuous geography.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "At least one repeated landmark proves both opponents remain in the same continuous geography."

invariants.rule: The terminal frame contains both opponents and preserves an unresolved, nonlethal state with no franchise likeness.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal frame contains both opponents and preserves an unresolved, nonlethal state with no franchise likeness."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
